daily.topThemeTitle: Passkey Phishing and Rising IoT Attacks Widen Campus Security Gaps
daily.topThemeBody: THE Journal reports new passkey-phishing techniques are driving cloud account takeovers and EdTech Magazine tracks an 11% year-over-year rise in IoT attacks including in higher ed, as EdSurge profiles an Alabama high school building hands-on cybersecurity training to meet the moment.
